config.extra_rule: Below the attachment8 reference threshold, assume intensity grade zero in both modalities. At or above threshold, no 1-6 point grade can be inferred from a threshold alone.
config.parent_rule: Diagnostic only: separately ranked panel marginals are not raw-card intensities; do not clip children to parent and silently change the scoring definition.
config.scope: One primary52 scorecard view: 50 panel-relative estimates plus two separately identified chemical-threshold scenarios. No original-card absolute calibration claim, no crowd-to-panel label substitution, no new predictive model family.

main_panel_selection: Conditional median: lowest pre-existing primary45 OOF MAE; clipping worsens this metric and does not recover raw-card semantics.
limitations: Panel grades remain relative estimates, not original 0-6 intensity recovery.
The two zero grades require the reference threshold to apply to both modalities; no expert labels or separate modality calibration exists.
A threshold alone identifies no above-threshold 1-6 intensity; such future inputs receive no invented point grade.
Do not include 500 proxy estimates in panel accuracy metrics. Historical OOF folds informed exploration.
